physical.title: toggle
physical.summary:
Toggle carved in ivory, of a seal head, mouth nostrils and whiskers neatly engraved, with two precise holes drilled (gimlet or metal drill) for eyes, perhaps originally filled with baleen or other dark inlay. The raw material perhaps from the tip of a walrus tusk, but discoloured as though it was either fossil ivory, or had been buried. On the underside are two holes drilled for a thong, so that it may have been used as one of a pair of heads in a seal pull.
Modern plastic tie attached.
